title: Enjoy a Halloween Bash with Mothman and more at the WV Culture Center

content:
CHARLESTON, WV (WVNS) -- The West Virginia Department of Tourism welcomes local families to take part in a special Halloween event.

According to a press release, the Halloween Bash, an entertaining, family-friendly event, will take place on Thursday, October 29, 2026, spanning from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at the West Virginia Culture Center within the State Capitol Complex.

The Great Hall will be changed into a haven for haunts, packed with activities and entertainment for both kids and adults. Guests are encouraged to come dressed in costume or Halloween attire, the release stated. Prizes will be given out for the best-dressed guest in three groups: pre-K and under, kindergarten through second grade, and third through fifth grade.

Other exciting details for the bash, as stated in the release, include:

  • Miniature golf: Guests are more than welcome to try their hand at the six-hole, Halloween-themed mini golf course.

  • Cryptid character meet-and-greets: the popular legends of the Mountain State, Mothman and the Flatwoods Monster, will be available for photographs.

  • Craft stations: Children will have the opportunity to create their own spooky crafts to take home as a keepsake.

  • Folklore storytime: Enjoy a scary story during a reading of some of the folklore from areas around West Virginia.

  • Cryptid scavenger hunt: Embark on a quest within the State Museum to uncover legendary West Virginia cryptids hidden throughout the exhibits. Little thrill-seekers who find an icon will get a unique prize.

Parking is available for free in the Capitol Complex parking garage. For more information regarding the celebration, visit the event's Facebook page.
